title: "Kernel Functions"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This example demonstrates various kernel functions (linear, RBF, polynomial, sigmoid) using the `aoclda` package.

```{r library}
library(aoclda)
```

## Data

```{r data}
X <- matrix(
  c(
    1.0, -1.0, 2.0,
    2.0, 0.0, -2.0
  ),
  nrow = 3, ncol = 2
)
Y <- matrix(
  c(
    0.5, 1.0,
    -0.5, 3.0
  ),
  nrow = 2, ncol = 2
)
```

## Linear Kernel

```{r linear}
lin <- linear_kernel(X, Y)
print(lin)
```

## RBF Kernel

```{r rbf}
rbf <- rbf_kernel(X, Y, gamma = 0.5)
print(rbf)
```

## Polynomial Kernel

```{r polynomial}
poly <- polynomial_kernel(X, degree = 2, gamma = 1.0, coef0 = 1.0)
print(poly)
```

## Sigmoid Kernel

```{r sigmoid}
sig <- sigmoid_kernel(X, gamma = 0.2, coef0 = 0.0)
print(sig)
```
